description: The SIS enclave's data diode should carry traffic in exactly one direction: disinfection status out to the OT historian, nothing back in. This evidence includes one packet observed the wrong way.

flows.notes: PLANTED VIOLATION: a single packet observed flowing OT historian -> SIS PLC, the direction a one-way hardware diode should make physically impossible. Indicates either the diode has been bypassed/miswired or this boundary is not actually diode-enforced as the deployment documentation claims.
